policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
            try {
                var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
                var model = body?["model"];
                return model != null && model.Type == JTokenType.String ? (string)model : string.Empty;
            } catch (Exception) {
                return string.Empty;
            }
        }" />
        <set-variable name="streamRequested" value="@{
            try {
                var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
                var stream = body?["stream"];
                return stream != null && stream.Type != JTokenType.Null && !(stream.Type == JTokenType.Boolean && !(bool)stream);
            } catch (Exception) {
                return true;
            }
        }" />
